package generatedtest

import (
 "context"
 "errors"
 "strings"
 "sync"
 "testing"
 "time"
 "github.com/DiLRandI/confgen/config"
)

func TestGeneratedConsumer(t *testing.T) {
 env := config.Env(config.WithLookupEnv(func(key string) (string, bool) {
  values := map[string]string{"PASSWORD":"sentinel", "CHECK_INTEGER":"7", "CHECK_PRIVATE":"ignored"}
  v, ok := values[key]; return v, ok
 }))
 file := config.Reader("file", strings.NewReader(`{"integer":3}`), config.FormatJSON)
 cfg, err := Load(file, env)
 if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 if cfg.Integer != 7 || cfg.Text != "hello" || cfg.Boolean || cfg.Huge != ^uint64(0) || cfg.Signed != -9223372036854775808 || cfg.Timeout != 90*time.Minute || cfg.Nested.Endpoint != "local" || cfg.Private != "private" || cfg.Password != "sentinel" || len(cfg.Backends)!=1 || cfg.Backends[0].Port != 80 || !cfg.Backends[0].Options.TLS || cfg.Labels["a"]!="first" { t.Fatalf("unexpected configuration") }
 reversed, err := Load(env, file)
 if err != nil || reversed.Integer != 3 { t.Fatalf("reversed load: %v",err) }
 cfg.Backends[0].Name = "changed"; cfg.Labels["a"] = "changed"
 again := MustLoad(env)
 if again.Backends[0].Name != "primary" || again.Labels["a"] != "first" { t.Fatal("mutable defaults shared across loads") }
 ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background()); cancel()
 if got, err := LoadContext(ctx,env); got != nil || !errors.Is(err,context.Canceled) { t.Fatal("cancellation not preserved") }
 var wg sync.WaitGroup
 for range 10 { wg.Go(func(){ if _,err:=Load(file,env);err!=nil{t.Error(err)} }) }; wg.Wait()
}

func TestMustLoadPanics(t *testing.T) {
 defer func(){if recover()==nil{t.Fatal("MustLoad did not panic")}}()
 MustLoad()
}
